bagPolicy.summary: Dakota hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Underground parking is in the Public Ramp on 10th Street and LaSalle, entering on LaSalle, with skyway access until midnight. Metered street parking is on 10th Street. Drive-up valet opens at 5pm at the corner of 10th Street and Nicollet Mall, in front of the Target lobby doors, on the night of your ticketed show.
parking.quote: Underground parking is available in the Public Ramp located on 10th Street and LaSalle (enter on LaSalle).

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Dakota. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Dakota serves a chef-driven menu of elevated comfort food, seasonal specialties and craft cocktails, with a dinner menu and a bar menu. Dining starts at 5:30pm, and your ticket confirmation email lists kitchen close times.
concessions.quote: Our chef-driven menu features elevated comfort food, seasonal specialties, and craft cocktails.

accessibility.summary: Dakota offers accessible seating. Call the box office at 612.332.5299 if you have questions or concerns about accessibility.
accessibility.quote: We do offer accessible seating. Please call the box office if you have concerns about accessibility.

reEntry.summary: Dakota hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Dakota is a paperless, will call only ticket office, so printed or digital tickets aren't valid. Bring a photo ID matching the name on the purchase to will call. Dakota is all ages, everyone needs a ticket, and the box office is open Monday through Friday 10am to 7pm and weekends 12pm to 7pm.
ticketPickup.quote: We are a paperless Will Call only ticket office. No printed or digital tickets are valid. A photo ID matching the name on the purchase will be verified at Will Call for entry.

gates.summary: Dakota is on the first floor of Target Plaza Headquarters at 10th Street and Nicollet Mall in downtown Minneapolis. Check your event page for the door time.
gates.quote: Dakota is located on the first floor of Target Plaza Headquarters on 10th Street and Nicollet Mall in Downtown Minneapolis.
